The AbuseIPDB connector ingests blacklisted IP address data from the AbuseIPDB threat intelligence platform into Microsoft Sentinel. Data includes IP addresses, abuse confidence scores, country codes, and last reported timestamps.

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB Blacklist (using Sentinel Connector Builder Agent)
AbuseIPDB Threat Intelligence
AbuseIPDB - All Sign-Ins from Blacklisted IPs
AbuseIPDB - All Sign-Ins from Blacklisted IPs
properties.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'Interactive'),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'NonInteractive'),
(AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ServicePrincipal'),
(AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ManagedIdentity'),
(ADFSSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ADFS')
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, IPAddress, AbuseScore, Country, AppName, ResultType, SignInType
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Device Network Connections to Blacklisted IPs
AbuseIPDB - Device Network Connections to Blacklisted IPs
properties.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteIP in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.RemoteIP == $right.IpAddress
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, AbuseScore, Country, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ActionType

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Blacklist Geographic Threat Distribution
AbuseIPDB - Blacklist Geographic Threat Distribution
properties.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| summarize
    TotalIPs = dcount(IpAddress),
    AvgConfidenceScore = round(avg(AbuseConfidenceScore), 1),
    MaxConfidenceScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore),
    HighConfidenceCount = countif(AbuseConfidenceScore >= 90),
    CriticalCount = countif(AbuseConfidenceScore == 100)
    by CountryCode
| extend HighConfidencePct = round(100.0 * HighConfidenceCount / TotalIPs, 1)
| order by TotalIPs desc
| take 30

tags.name: description
tags.value: Analyzes the geographic distribution of blacklisted IPs to identify countries with the highest concentration of abusive IP addresses. Useful for threat landscape awareness and geo-blocking decisions.

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Network Device Logs with Blacklisted IPs
AbuseIPDB - Network Device Logs with Blacklisted IPs
properties.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
let IPSet = toscalar(BlacklistedIPs | summarize make_set(IpAddress));
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where SourceIP in (IPSet) or DestinationIP in (IPSet)
| extend MatchedIP = iff(set_has_element(IPSet, SourceIP), SourceIP, DestinationIP)
| extend Direction = iff(SourceIP == MatchedIP, "Inbound", "Outbound")
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.MatchedIP == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, Activity, MatchedIP, Direction, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, AbuseScore, Country, LogSeverity
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc

properties.query:

SecurityAlert

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Successful Sign-in from High Confidence Abusive IP
AbuseIPDB - Successful Sign-in from High Confidence Abusive IP
properties.query:
let HighConfidenceIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 80
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, SignInType = 'Interactive'),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, SignInType = 'NonInteractive'),
(ADFSSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName = ResourceDisplayName, SignInType = 'ADFS')
| where IPAddress in ((HighConfidenceIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner HighConfidenceIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AbuseScore, Country, AppDisplayName, SignInType
| extend AccountName = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[0]), AccountUPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1])
properties.description: Triggers when a user successfully authenticates (Interactive, Non-Interactive, or ADFS) from an IP address with an AbuseIPDB confidence score >= 80. Covers all user sign-in types to detect compromised credentials, token replay, VPN misuse, or credential stuffing success.

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Brute Force Attempt from Blacklisted IP
AbuseIPDB - Brute Force Attempt from Blacklisted IP
properties.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType != 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'Interactive'),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType != 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'NonInteractive'),
(ADFSSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType != 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ADFS')
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| summarize
    FailedAttempts = count(),
    DistinctUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    TargetUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
    TargetApps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
    ErrorCodes = make_set(ResultType, 10),
    SignInTypes = make_set(SignInType),
    FirstAttempt = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastAttempt = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress
| where FailedAttempts >= 10
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project IPAddress, FailedAttempts, DistinctUsers, TargetUsers, AbuseScore, Country, SignInTypes, FirstAttempt, LastAttempt
properties.description: Detects multiple failed sign-in attempts (>= 10 in 1 hour) across Interactive, Non-Interactive, and ADFS sign-in logs originating from an AbuseIPDB blacklisted IP. Indicates active brute force or password spray attacks from known malicious infrastructure.

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Windows Logon from Blacklisted IP
AbuseIPDB - Windows Logon from Blacklisted IP
properties.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventID == 4624
| where LogonType in (3, 10)
| where isnotempty(IpAddress)
| where IpAddress !in ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '-')
| where IpAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, IpAddress, AbuseScore, Country, LogonTypeName, Process
| extend HostName = tostring(split(Computer, '.')[0])
properties.description: Detects successful Windows network logon (Type 3) or RDP logon (Type 10) from an AbuseIPDB blacklisted IP with confidence score >= 75. Indicates direct compromise of on-premises infrastructure from known malicious sources.

properties.displayName: AbuseIPDB - Inbound Network Traffic from Blacklisted IP
AbuseIPDB - Inbound Network Traffic from Blacklisted IP
properties.query:
let HighConfidenceIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where SourceIP in ((HighConfidenceIPs | project IpAddress))
| summarize
    ConnectionCount = count(),
    DistinctDestinations = dcount(DestinationIP),
    DestPorts = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Devices = make_set(strcat(DeviceVendor, ' - ', DeviceProduct), 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SourceIP
| where ConnectionCount >= 5
| join kind=inner HighConfidenceIPs on $left.SourceIP == $right.IpAddress
| project SourceIP, ConnectionCount, DistinctDestinations, DestPorts, AbuseScore, Country, Devices, FirstSeen, LastSeen
properties.description: Detects repeated inbound network connections (>= 5 in 1 hour) from an AbuseIPDB blacklisted IP (score >= 75) as seen by firewalls, proxies, or IDS/IPS devices reporting to CommonSecurityLog. Indicates active scanning, exploitation attempts, or persistent C2 from known malicious infrastructure.
